scope: Interpretation and localization of the frozen 602 CTA records; no classification changes.

gap_groups.label: Duplicated regulatory and antigen-related families
gap_groups.rationale: Family annotations and developmental RNA explain their inclusion. Exact-copy human function is largely uncharacterized.

gap_groups.label: Germ-cell structure and chromatin
gap_groups.rationale: Mouse sperm or testis studies provide biological leads; they do not establish the exact human protein.

gap_groups.label: Reproductive secretory families
gap_groups.rationale: Defensin, lipocalin and spermadhesin families. Human secretion is annotated for DEFB113 and LCN9; SPADH localization is unresolved.

gap_groups.label: Maternal / oocyte-associated proteins
gap_groups.rationale: Oocyte-associated RNA and, for PABPN1L, mouse maternal-to-zygotic transition experiments.

gap_groups.label: Other poorly characterized reproductive proteins
gap_groups.rationale: Measured reproductive association and coding annotations supply the main support; family names do not establish tumor specificity.

gap_groups.label: Sensory channel
gap_groups.rationale: Mouse taste physiology identifies a normal-function question. The human taste-cell compartment remains to be resolved.

gap_groups.label: Unnamed loci and a readthrough
gap_groups.rationale: Six unnamed coding loci and the ATF7-NPFF readthrough. Lack of a stable name or a dedicated experiment does not negate a qualifying coding reference.

concern_groups.label: Direct adult normal-tissue protein
concern_groups.next_action: Adjudicate the tissue and cell findings against the normal-expression policy.

concern_groups.label: Physiological state or producing compartment
concern_groups.next_action: Identify the expressing normal cell, physiological state and relevant protection tier.

concern_groups.label: Normal RNA / function requires localization
concern_groups.next_action: Resolve native human producing cells, protein abundance and assay specificity.

concern_groups.label: Normal assay cannot separate related copies
concern_groups.next_action: Resolve the exact copy or proteoform before assigning a member-specific exclusion.

concern_groups.label: Plasma affinity-assay association
concern_groups.next_action: Verify the measured molecule, reagent specificity and normal source tissue.

concern_groups.label: Unnamed locus; little characterization
concern_groups.next_action: Keep the qualifying coding record; do not borrow a named paralog’s papers. Experimental characterization is a priority, not a new admission requirement.

concern_groups.label: Shared protein annotation
concern_groups.next_action: Map the observed protein sequence to the selected locus before transferring experiments.

concern_groups.label: Readthrough-specific evidence missing
concern_groups.next_action: Verify junction-spanning RNA and the selected product; parent-gene experiments do not establish the readthrough.

concern_groups.label: Experimental challenge to protein-coding status
concern_groups.next_action: Reconcile the noncoding interpretation with the selected reference translation.

concern_groups.label: Proteoform attribution
concern_groups.next_action: Assign measurements to GALP or alarin and their specific sequences.

concern_groups.label: RNA without selective protein detection
concern_groups.next_action: Reconcile the tested samples and assay sensitivity with older cross-reactive protein claims.

concerns.observation: Normal lactating breast expression; tumor antibody-blockade studies also identify a cell-surface target.
concerns.next_action: Retain lactation and mammary-cell context in the normal-expression decision.

concerns.observation: Reagent-discriminated protein findings include normal donor serum and fetal / placental contexts.
concerns.next_action: Identify the adult producing tissue; serum detection alone does not locate the source cell.

concerns.observation: Human hair-cuticle RNA and protein findings.
concerns.next_action: Distinguish mature hair from living follicular and regenerative cells.

concerns.observation: Adult and fetal human brain immunoblots, with autophagy and receptor-turnover experiments.
concerns.next_action: Assess normal brain protein expression and the cells producing it.

concerns.observation: Human keratinocyte / skin RNA and protein, with skin-barrier experiments.
concerns.next_action: Assess normal epidermal protein and barrier function.

concerns.observation: The exact readthrough protein is reported in normal human hepatocytes and liver microsomes; native localization is largely endoplasmic reticulum.
concerns.next_action: Apply the normal hepatocyte evidence to the readthrough, keeping native and overexpression localization separate.

concerns.observation: Adult male human midbrain immunostaining and catecholamine-related functional experiments.
concerns.next_action: Assess the normal neuronal population and sex-specific expression.

concerns.observation: Human brain RNA and neuronal protein staining; channel function studied in expression systems.
concerns.next_action: Assess normal neuronal protein, antibody specificity and cell identity.

concerns.observation: A processed secreted GPR83 agonist; reported normal RNA includes pituitary, testis, heart and brain.
concerns.next_action: Localize native human production and quantify protein; recombinant secretion does not establish native tissue abundance.

concerns.observation: Human RNA / methylation studies include brain and disease-control comparisons.
concerns.next_action: Resolve normal cell expression; RNA association does not establish a protein or inflammasome function.

concerns.observation: Normal activated CD8/CD19-cell and nasal RNA.
concerns.next_action: Resolve normal immune / airway protein; do not transfer SCGB3A2 staining to SCGB1D4.

concerns.observation: Selective immunoaffinity mass spectrometry did not detect relaxin-1 in the tested samples despite RNA; older assays could cross-react with relaxin-2.
concerns.next_action: Record sample scope and detection limits; nondetection in these samples does not prove universal absence or negate the coding annotation.

concerns.observation: GALP and the alternatively spliced alarin product have distinct sequence and tissue interpretations.
concerns.next_action: Map each assay and claimed normal compartment to the measured product.

concerns.observation: The reference coding record qualifies, but no dedicated study verifies the exact readthrough product.
concerns.next_action: Seek junction-spanning RNA and sequence-specific protein data; do not substitute ATF7 or NPFF measurements.

concerns.observation: UniProt Q8TCC3 links this locus and two others to mitochondrial ribosomal protein uL30m.
concerns.next_action: Resolve the selected locus / sequence before crediting uL30m experiments.

concerns.observation: A DEFB108 assay reports predominant testis RNA and low liver RNA without resolving the current copies.
concerns.next_action: Resolve the DEFB108 copy measured in liver.

concerns.observation: Normal hippocampal staining uses an antibody shared by H3.X and H3.Y; tumor-cell mass spectrometry resolves H3.Y.
concerns.next_action: Resolve which histone variant accounts for normal neuronal staining.

concerns.observation: A combined PRAMEF18/PRAMEF19 RNA feature appears in treated human pulmonary-arterial smooth-muscle cells.
concerns.next_action: Resolve the copy and native expression; this is not exact PRAMEF18 protein evidence.

concerns.observation: TAF11-like macrosatellite RNA is reported in testis, fetal brain and whole brain; the assay does not resolve this copy.
concerns.next_action: Obtain copy-specific normal brain evidence before assigning a member-specific exclusion.

localization_notes.scope: Human ZP4 in transduced cells and TNBC cell / xenograft models; oocyte staining.
localization_notes.finding: Antibodies bind the extracellular portion of ZP4 on transduced cells; ZP4 CAR-T cells recognize tumor models. The study supplies surface-recognition evidence.

localization_notes.scope: Human cancer cell models; the normal lactating mammary compartment also expresses BTN1A1.
localization_notes.finding: Cell-surface BTN1A1 and antibody-mediated checkpoint blockade are studied in cancer models.

localization_notes.scope: Reagent-discriminated CRIPTO3 in serum and experimental cell models.
localization_notes.finding: Serum protein detection supports extracellular occurrence; it does not establish the producing tissue, active secretion or an exposed tumor-cell epitope.

localization_notes.scope: Engineered endocrine host cells and receptor assays.
localization_notes.finding: A processed, amidated secreted product activates GPR83. Native human tissue abundance was not established by the recombinant secretion experiment.

localization_notes.scope: Native human hepatocytes / microsomes versus transfected cells.
localization_notes.finding: Normal hepatocyte evidence places the readthrough in the endoplasmic reticulum. Cell-membrane annotation also includes model-dependent results and is not proof of an exposed tumor epitope.

localization_notes.scope: Cell-membrane localization annotation without extracellular orientation.
localization_notes.finding: Cell-membrane association alone does not establish an antibody-accessible extracellular region.
No localization annotation or specific human secretion experiment was verified. The spermadhesin family name does not supply that evidence.

localization_notes.scope: UniProt A0A2R8Y4Y8 maps two Ensembl loci.
localization_notes.finding: The shared entry predicts secretion. This is a candidate localization, not exact-locus experimental secretion.
